name: Mharie
source:
Mharie is a manakravter in [url=/c45469]Melano's[/url] party, who participated in the assault on Rughzenhaide. She is also [url=/c45467]Koko's[/url] partner and superior, even though she, too, appeared no older than Koko.

Mharie is soft-spoken, but suffers from a speech impediment.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/fault-milestone-one-directors-cut/description?lang=es]Fault's Kickstarter[/url]]
